t: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
d: A respected member of the community shoots a thief and is hailed as a hero. However, it is found that he himself is wanted for being in the James gang.

t: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
d: When a man is murdered in Wichita, Earp wants the Newton gang for it but Allen Pinkerton is interfering and more interested in recovering some stolen money.

t: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
d: A suffragette invited to Wichita to give a speech is interrupted by men supporting Senator Teague who is against women voting.

t: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
d: Earp is forced with the help of Mr. Cousin to go into the rough Bushwhacker area to track down a man wanted for murder.

t: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
d: Two ranchers have started a range war that is spilling into Wichita where innocent people could be killed.

t: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
d: Earp learns Masterson has dropped out of school and is a scout for the Army.

t: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
d: The Taylors open a café in Wichita but word that he is a cousin of criminal Mannon Clements causes strife for them.

t: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
st: Dodge City Gets a New Marshal
d: Earp takes the job of Dodge City Marshal. He arrives to find the Sheriff and his deputy under siege and the men on Front Street trying to kill him.

t: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
d: The Big T outfit is angry with Earp's attempt to tame Dodge City so they decide to ambush him with the help of Jim Kelley.

t: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
st: The Double Life of Dora Hand
d: The dance hall run by Dora Hand is a constant site of trouble between the buffalo hunters and railroad workers so Earp is called on to help.

t: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
d: Pete Albright tries to hire gunfighter Clay Allison to kill Earp to open up Dodge City. Allison won't take money but is willing to kill Earp.

t: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
d: The Judge's daughter has fallen for Earp but Earp realizes there is no future for them given his job.

t: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
st: A Quiet Day in Dodge City
d: A newspaper man from New York comes to Dodge City to write about it expecting a wild and dangerous town but finds the town quiet.

t: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
d: Thad Milburn is fed up with being cheated by people in Dodge City causing him to wound two people and take refuge in a warehouse. Earp decides to investigate the situation.

t: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
d: Dora is forcing Kelly to sell his saloon so Albright and McGuire see an opportunity to not only buy it but to get rid of Earp.

t: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
d: As Jim Kelly and Dora Hand prepare to wed, Jim Rellance from Texas hopes to marry Dora. Dora tells him to find a younger girl and Earp tells him to leave Dodge City.

t: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
d: Bat returns to Dodge City on the stage with the lovely Nellie Wright hoping to earn a star. He quickly ends up in a gunfight and learns Nellie is part of an outlaw gang but she wants out.

t: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
st: The Lonesomest Man in the World
d: New deputy Bat Masterson mistakenly shoots a drunk with an empty gun in the back to protect Hal.

t: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
d: The George Morris gang tries to take over Dodge City while Earp and Sheriff Bassett are gone. They succeed but Bat escapes capture to catch Earp.

t: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
d: The Dutch Henry gang is rustling cattle and killing ranch hands on some of the smaller ranches around town. Sheriff Bassett is sick so Earp and Bat decide to go undercover into the gang.

t: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
d: Earp is not happy with Judge Tobin's habit of being liberal with sentencing men to hang.

t: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
d: Two Cheyennes have been killed, which can start a new Indian war. The Cheyenne chief plans to attack Dodge City for revenge.

t: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
d: Mrs. McGill resorts to guns to save their water and pasture for Hap Dorsett who she hopes will marry her daughter.

t: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
st: The Man Who Rode with Custer
d: Earp is involved in the backlash from Custer's last battle when crooked Indian agents come to Dodge City to blame the army and Capt. Benteen for the loss.

t: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
d: Earp arrests a drunk Sgt. Craig for killing an Indian in a Dodge City store. However, the Captain at Fort Dodge has other ideas about whether it is a crime for a soldier to kill an Indian.

t: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
d: Ben Thompson returns as a dealer at a saloon outside Dodge City. When he is caught cheating, he engages in a gunfight with several hands from the Circle Bar ranch.

t: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
d: George Morris is willing to pay $1500 to Rule Hawes who was a Tennessee sharpshooter to kill Earp.

t: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
d: Wells Fargo asks Earp to help stop holdups by Curly Bill Brocius' gang at the station called the Little Alamo.

t: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
d: Earp receives word that Fred Colby has been released from prison. Earp has no knowledge of him so he fills in the blanks with info from Hal, others and old city records.

t: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
d: Buffalo Bill Cody and Ned Buntline bring a German prince through Dodge City. They ask Earp to help fake a robbery to provide excitement for the Prince.

t: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
d: Two stage lines are competing over a single route with the feud turning into a gun battle in Dodge City as each side outbids the other for hired guns.

t: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
d: Bat is running for sheriff at the urging of Earp but Bat is having trouble controlling his temper as his opponent tries to bait him into fights.
